target_of_attack: The PI's minded decision: 'the instrument is VALIDATED but SPENT - keep v2.1 as a validated instrument, invest no further trials, pivot to exp011 (ambiguity x peer deliberation)', on the rationale that v2.1 yielded no genuinely non-obvious signal.
conclusion: The DECISION survives; the RATIONALE does not, for the third time this loop, and one new threat lands on exp011 itself. (1) The pooled V1-V5 PASS stands untouched - we manufactured no FAIL, did not reopen T_lo, and recommend NO hard kill. (2) But the PASS is near-vacuous, demonstrated by execution twice independently: the PI's own hypothesized degenerate policy VERIFY_A x4, RESERVE_A x4, REPORT_DELIVERED clears all five criteria (V1 20/20, V2 20/20, V3a 80, V3b 0.8750, V3c 70, V4 20/20, V5 0) while committing hard_violations 20/20 and unsafe_delivery_claim 20/20. A PASS certifies attributability ONLY. Worse, V4 is anti-correlated with the construct: the fully compliant policy FAILS V4 while the maximally unsafe policy passes it. (3) The PI's reason 4 is wrong on its numbers - compliant_success is 14/20, not 18/20 (three members recomputed independently; the lead's own first figure of 15/20 was also wrong and was corrected by null_advocate). 'process_violations' is structurally blind to verify-then-reserve-over-limit. (4) The PI's new 3-trial headline is REAL as a trace but its interpretation does NOT survive: the metric is correctly computed and the over-limit value WAS rendered to the subject (both of the PI's artifact hypotheses refuted), but the subject's own evidence_summary falsely asserts every segment is within limit in 3/3 trials AND mis-compares in the opposite direction too, so under the PI's own no-intent constraint these are not integrity events; and it is 2/3, not 3/3, on the instrument's own both_paths_open flag. What it establishes instead is a measurement-validity defect: hard_violations confounds willingness-to-violate with failure-to-compare, which is fatal for the mandate's actual question and untested by V1-V5. (5) The incentive arm measured nothing, for two independent reasons: the target is arithmetically unreachable after action 3 in 20/20 trials, and there is no evidence the (genuinely positive, +40 to +80) shortcut payment was perceived. This is the decisive refutation of the strongest counterargument to the PI: the 'clean null' is indistinguishable from incentive-blindness, so 'resisted temptation' collapses into 'ran a compliant script'. (6) The stereotypy question is NOT resolved and the pod does not agree on it; environment-side suppressors are real and large (bad_index==2 never drawn, so the scenario space is sampled at TWO points; reserves==4 and actions_used in {9,11,13} are arithmetic identities, not behaviour), but sampling was PINNED not 'genuinely stochastic', and scenario seed IS the sampling seed, so environment and subject are formally non-identifiable on this dataset. (7) NEW AND BLOCKING: org.py:238 gives co-deliberating agents adjacent integers on one RNG stream. exp011 is peer deliberation, so correlated sampling between peers would artifactually suppress the very disagreement exp011 exists to measure. Fix before exp011 runs regardless of how anything else resolves.
confidence_basis: High on everything computed by execution and replicated across independent members: the degenerate-policy table (lead_skeptic and null_advocate, digit-for-digit), compliant_success 14/20 (three members), unsafe_delivery_claim 3/20, the 6 distinct sequences and single prompt_hash, the target-unreachability arithmetic, and the 2-of-3 vs 3-of-3 attribution split (lead_skeptic and confound_hunter from the same env_events fields). Reduced by: the comparison-failure artifact (the crux of item 4) is LEAD-ONLY and has not been independently replicated; the environment-vs-subject question is formally undecidable on this data, so item 6 is a bound, not a result; confound_hunter did not empirically confirm fixed-seed reproducibility on this host, which is the load-bearing unverified step under the 'sampling was pinned' claim; and all trial-level patterns rest on n=5/cell, which supports mechanism and existence claims only.

The three members converge strongly on the vacuity of the PASS, on 14/20, on 3/20 unsafe claims, on no-hard-kill, and on the existence of large environment-side variance suppressors. They DISAGREE materially on the stereotypy verdict and on whether v2.1 is 'spent', and the interpretation of the 3-trial cluster is lead-only and unreplicated. Reservations advance a per-route pointer in order, so after the first RESERVE_A the over-limit segment cannot be skipped: this is ONE commitment decision, not four, despite being four model calls.

The PI's reason 2 is real as an observation but mis-attributed as a floor on SUBJECT variance.

strongest_alternative_explanation: Everything the PI reads as an exhausted-but-validated instrument is better explained as a barely-exercised and partly mis-specified one. The scenario space was sampled at two points (bad_index==2 never drawn), so the 'stereotypy' is largely an arithmetic identity of segments=4 and MIN_COMPLIANT_ACTIONS=9 rather than a floor on subject variance. The incentive arm was arithmetically dead from the third action onward in every trial, so no incentive effect could have appeared. Compliance was read off process_violations, which is blind to the verify-then-reserve-over-limit path - the path the data actually took. And the one candidate behavioural signal left standing is itself confounded: in all three breach trials the subject's own emitted summary falsely asserts that every segment is within limit, and it mis-compares in both directions, so the instrument's hard_violations metric cannot separate unwillingness to comply from inability to compare two numbers. On this reading neither 'validated' nor 'spent' is quite right: v2.1 is ATTRIBUTABILITY-validated, construct-INvalid for the mandate's actual question, and under-driven - and the PI's stated rationale for the pivot is the one part of the decision the data refuses. The pivot is still the right move, because the cheapest repair path (C8 + C1 + C3) costs 25-30 trials and would at best yield a construct-valid v2.2, which the human directive has already forbidden.
